Will you escape the five eerie floors or succumb to the relentless terror lurking in the shadows?
instructions: Use mouse or touch controls to play.

title: Silly Snake Game
name: Silly Snake Game
description: Silly Snake Game transforms the beloved snake genre into a hilarious race against time. Propel your quirky snake as it gains speed and size with each circle collected. With unpredictable twists and strategic maneuvers, keep your reflexes sharp to navigate the frenzied arena without crash landing.
